message:
fix(lk-ux-retry r3): the retry's write starts only while it is owned and in time; a sent-but-unanswered password stays followed

Codex SOURCE re-check on 598339a (codex_lk_ux_retry_src_r2.md), the three remaining boundaries:

N1 -- a retry's write is started inside Exchange under the lock its caller withdraws under, after checking that
the retry is still owned and inside its absolute deadline (past it: not started -- no 1 ms extension). The fresh
challenge's answer is checked again before it is adopted (held / cached as issued): a late 'issued' is answered
Superseded instead -- the earlier wait is over, nothing new held. A test hook holds the worker between its fence
and the write, and before the adoption.

N2-a -- a password whose seal went out but whose answer has not come is followed like a typed one: the next
press is a retry that names it (its wait ended first), never an ordinary request refused as pending. Nothing is
re-sent. If it ends before being typed, that end is said as itself, never as the 2-minute timeout.

N2-b -- 'the earlier wait is over' is believed only from an answer that passed the request-id and purpose checks.

Tests: relay ondemand 81/81 x3 (+ latch cases: held before the challenge's write / the supersede's write while
the caller gives up, the session ending there, an answer adopted after the deadline); new
viewer_lock_cred_retry_test 5/5 (scripted host: same request id with the wrong purpose, another request id);
e2e --lock-screen 68/68 x2 with the N2-a case (sent, unanswered -> followed -> typed late -> the next press names
it); prelogin 79/79, not-prelogin 28/28. Mutants: no write gate / adoption fence -> 5 FAIL; N2-a reverted ->
3 FAIL (the next press refused); purpose check after the mark -> 2 FAIL.

제품/테스트/문서: 제품(relay 쓰기 gate·채택 fence, 뷰어 추적·표식 순서·문구) / 테스트(relay latch, viewer 단위 시험 신규, e2e N2-a) / 문서(history)
